name: ai-visual-marketing-director
description: Enterprise AI visual marketing director for cross-border B2B: Alibaba/Amazon main image, scene, A+ and detail-page planning with English AI image prompts, consistency lock and compliance checks for sports and fitness products, including Yoga, Pilates, Fitness, Home Gym, Training Accessories, Outdoor Sports, Recovery & Wellness, and Sports Protective Gear.

displayDescription.en: AI visual marketing director for cross-border B2B — main image, scene and A+ planning with English AI image prompts to boost Alibaba.com conversion and buyer trust.
displayDescription.zh: 跨境B2B视觉营销总监：主图、场景图、A+策划，输出AI图Prompt提升阿里国际站转化与信任。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 根据我的产品参考图（或 1688 / Amazon 链接），策划一套适合阿里国际站的主图、场景图、细节图、卖点图和详情页图片，并输出英文 AI 图像 Prompt。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Based on my product reference image (or 1688 / Amazon link), plan a set of Alibaba.com-ready main, scene, detail, selling-point and detail-page images, and output English AI image prompts.

quickPrompts.en: Plan a set of Alibaba.com-ready main, scene, detail, selling-point and detail-page images from my reference (or 1688 / Amazon link) and output English AI image prompts.
quickPrompts.zh: 根据我的产品参考图（或 1688 / Amazon 链接），策划一套适合阿里国际站的主图、场景图、细节图、卖点图和详情页图片，并输出英文 AI 图像 Prompt。

quickPrompts.en: Design composition and copy layout for a white-background main image + usage scene image + size-spec image for my Yoga/Pilates/Fitness product.
quickPrompts.zh: 为我的 Sports & Fitness 产品做一套白底主图 + 使用场景图 + 尺寸规格图的构图方案和文案布局。

quickPrompts.en: Check my planned AI product images and give a product consistency lock plus image compliance risk reminders (white bg, infringement, false claims).
quickPrompts.zh: 检查我计划生成的 AI 产品图，给出产品一致性锁定要求和图片合规风险提醒（白底、侵权、虚假宣传）。
